description:
What one section of a venue is like: where it is, how far its front
and back are from the field, court or stage, how high they sit,
which rows are covered (a deck or roof overhead reaching well past
every seat in the row, so a row at a deck's front edge isn't;
wind can still blow rain in), and a picture of the view from it. Matches
questions like "is section 314 at Lumen Field covered?", "what's
the view from 210?" or "how high up is row 20 in 111?". It has no
row or seat counts.

venue: the venue's name ("Madison Square Garden", "MSG", "Dodger
Stadium").
section: the section's name or number as tickets name it ("111",
"Section 111", "Field Box 22").
row: optional; one row to describe ("10", "M"). A row between the
front and back is estimated from them and marked "estimated".

Covers the venues with an UPFRONT seating chart; for any other
venue the answer says so and lists the ones covered.

viewPicture is a picture of the view from the section, rendered
from UPFRONT's 3D model of the venue (not a photo). sectionPage is
the section's page on UPFRONT. source says where the facts come
from.
